  · a 64×64 skin png (the old 64×32 works too — the face sits in the same place)

「自动选择」会按每个版本要求的 Java 挑。手动指定时只有主版本对得上才会用它: "Auto" picks the Java each version asks for. A manual choice is used only when its major version matches — otherwise it falls back to auto and says so in the log.
没找到任何 Java，点「重新扫描」，或者自己装一个。: No Java found — hit "Rescan", or install one.
最小堆不能大于最大堆 —— 两边会自动联动。: Min heap cannot exceed max heap — the two are linked automatically.
「游戏最多占用」是堆上限，实际用多少看玩法，整合包通常要往上调；越过红线（物理内: "Game can use up to" is the heap limit; actual usage depends on the game. Modpacks usually need more. Past the red line (60% of physical memory) Windows starts paging and the game gets slower the longer you play.
物理内存 {total} GB · 系统已用 {used} GB · 游戏最多占: Physical memory {total} GB · in use {used} GB · game can use up to {heap} GB · JVM overhead ~{overhead} GB

游戏里 F3 显示的版本类型（启动参数里的 ${version_type}）。留: The version type shown in game (F3) — ${version_type} in the launch arguments. Leave it empty to use the one from the version JSON.
英文冒号分隔 IP 和端口，例如 233.233.233.233:12345。1: Separate the IP and port with a colon, e.g. 233.233.233.233:12345. 1.20 and newer use QuickPlay; older versions use --server/--port.
「Java 虚拟机参数」原样追加到 java 命令行；填错了 JVM 会拒绝启动: "Java VM arguments" are appended to the java command line as-is — a typo there makes the JVM refuse to start. "Game arguments" are appended after the version's own arguments, and win when an option appears in both.
你需要先安装 Forge、Fabric 等 Mod 加载器才能使用 Mod，请在: You need a mod loader such as Forge or Fabric before you can use mods. Install one of those versions from the download page.
如果你已经安装了 Mod 加载器，那么你很可能选错了版本，点下面的「版本选择」切: If you do have a mod loader installed, you probably picked the wrong version — use "Select version" below to switch.
下载和安装功能还没做（计划在 v0.4）。现在可以用「设置」页的游戏目录指向已经: Downloading and installing is not implemented yet (planned for v0.4). For now you can point the game directory on the Settings page at an already installed modpack.
「自动配置」还没做 —— 它会按装了哪些 Mod 和剩余内存动态算，先在下面自己: "Automatic" is not implemented yet — it would look at your installed mods and the memory left on the system. Drag the slider below for now. Unless you pick "Custom", the launcher-wide memory setting is used.
现在只有离线登录（正版登录还没做）。离线档案按名字生成 UUID，和朋友联机时名: Only offline login exists for now (online login is not implemented). Offline profiles derive their UUID from the name, so the name has to match when playing with friends.
跟随全局设置；这个版本要求 Java {n}，启动时按它挑。: Using global settings; this version requires Java {n}, which is picked at launch.
跟随全局设置；版本没写 Java 要求，按默认挑。: Using global settings; the version states no Java requirement, so the default is picked.

It will list the name, version and icon of every mod in the mods folder — no internet needed.
还没接上。现在按版本文件夹里有没有 saves/mods 自动判断，这里显示的就: Not wired up yet. For now this is decided automatically by whether the version folder contains saves/mods; what you see here is that result.
还没接上。这个版本想单独用一个窗口标题的话，先把值写进「游戏参数」里（--tit: Not wired up yet. To give this version its own window title for now, put the value into "Game arguments" (--title has not been verified to work on every version).
「内存管理」（自动挑 GC 参数）和「启动前执行命令」还是空壳 —— 画出来占个: "Memory management" (picking GC arguments automatically) and "Command to run before launch" are still empty shells — placeholders for now, the features come later.

一个用 Python + PyQt6 写的 Minecraft 启动器，能扫描本: A Minecraft launcher written in Python with PyQt6. It scans local versions and manages accounts; launching the game and downloading versions are still in progress.
这个启动器不向作者发送任何东西。: This launcher does not send anything to the author.
没有统计、没有遥测、没有崩溃上报。作者不会知道你在用它。: No analytics, no telemetry, no crash reporting. The author will never know you are using it.
你的档案信息（包括离线 UUID）只写在本机的配置目录里，不会上传。设置页底部写: Your account details (including the offline UUID) are only written to the local config folder and are never uploaded. The Settings page shows where that is.
启动器不会在后台联网；只有你主动操作（比如以后做版本下载）时才会访问网络。: The launcher never uses the network in the background — only when you ask it to (for example, downloading a version, once that exists).
以后做正版登录时，只有登录那一步会直连微软服务器，启动器本身不做中转。: When Microsoft sign-in arrives, only the login step talks to Microsoft directly; the launcher itself never relays your data.
游戏本身、以及你连接的服务器可能有各自的隐私政策，与本说明无关。: The game itself, and any server you join, may have their own privacy policies. This notice does not cover them.
